title: I Would Rather Die
overview: The protagonist Archie, considered the school loser, is bitten by a zombie and finds himself at the center of a mission to save the city alongside his friends Cris and Brenda.

episodes.title: Bolillo
episodes.overview: A zombie bites Archie and he's starting to turn into one himself. He's got only one option: kill himself…that or end up killing everyone else. Brenda -his lifelong crush- invites him to a costume party, last chance to tell her how he feels. The party is hosted by Brenda's ex and if Archie shows up, he's going to get his ass kicked. But hey, it's either that… or die a virgin. What would you do?

episodes.title: Red 40
episodes.overview: Archie goes looking for Brenda at Domingo's party -yes, the one he wasn't supposed to attend. Cris scolds him for being an irresponsible zombie and hides him in an abandoned house. Meanwhile, a group of religious ladies are hunting Archie down to "save his soul." Actually, pretty much everyone is looking for Archie, including Sarah Díaz, a rogue investigator with some very unconventional methods.

episodes.title: Don´t you plagarize!
episodes.overview: Díaz questions the students at school while Cris and Brenda try to kidnap Leopoldo-an insufferable guy, but the only one who has the info they need. Archie goes looking for help from the only person nerdy enough to actually assist him. Meanwhile, Wendy and her legion of church ladies stumble upon something that might just save their prayer group. Amen.

episodes.title: Drop of Fire
episodes.overview: Cris has a date with Leopoldo. Eww… or maybe not? Archie's getting dangerously close to losing control and the crew has no choice but to sneak into a crime scene. Brilliant. Bolillo, the dog, might be the key to a cure but an evil force is closing in on him first.

episodes.title: Don´t say "Zombie"
episodes.overview: The crew goes to mass. Not to confess but to try and neutralize the zombie threat. Díaz and her "paranormal" ideas are putting her job on the line. The real bitch of it is, if she gets fired, Archie's case will end up in the hands of someone with way less patience for zombies.

episodes.title: Monster or Monstre?
episodes.overview: Cris and Brenda round up the Mendoza kids to help find Archie. Even Beto, a stoner who never graduated, uploads a video. Gladys, the most religious of them all, sparks a full-on revolution inside the church group. Everything's reaching a breaking point. The crew is forced to seek help from someone unexpected.

episodes.title: Moria Mines
episodes.overview: Archie knows he's running out of time and wants to finally tell Brenda he loves her, officially ask her out and all that. Meanwhile, Díaz gets a lead that brings her closer to the truth behind the zombie infection, while the crew works on a cure for Archie. But the clock's ticking, and a new alliance puts Archie's life -or, well, his unlife- at serious risk. Will they manage to cure him in time?

episodes.title: Krakatoa
episodes.overview: The crew bands together to rescue Archie but to do that, they'll have to infiltrate the fortress where he's being held. Brenda turns to an old ally for help and together, Rambo-style, they launch Operation Save Archie before he becomes zombie chow.
